name: @pipeworx/mcp-opentopography

tools.name: point_elevation
tools.description: Elevation at a point (returns a 1-pixel raster URL — use opentopodata for direct point values).

tools.name: dem
tools.description: DEM raster for a bounding box (returns URL to GeoTIFF).

tools.name: datasets
tools.description: List the supported global DEM (digital elevation model) dataset identifiers available via OpenTopography: SRTMGL1, SRTMGL3, AW3D30, NASADEM, COP30, COP90.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-opentopography forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the opentopography pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
